attributes.name: The Sky Pharaoh
attributes.powers:
The Sky Pharaoh is immune to the Cold, Electricity, Mental, and Poison traits. While you act, damage dealt by the Sky Pharaoh is Mental damage that cannot be reduced.

Before you act, each character at your location is dealt an amount of Electricity damage equal to 1 plus the number of characters at this location.

You may bury the loot Mask of the Forgotten Pharaoh to add 2 dice to your check to defeat the Sky Pharaoh.

If undefeated, bury your discard pile.
